name: Lakeshore Vanguard FC
description: The oldest active team in the IRONWALL LEAGUE, the Vanguard FC were founded in 2185 out of the Tier 3 Lakeshore District by a consortium of mid-tier investors before Axiom Group acquired majority stake in 2201. Known for their signature teal-and-copper chrome kits and a tactical precision style that favors reflex augmentation over raw strength, they are the Ironclad's fiercest rivals and the team Tier 3 families have followed for generations.
story_hooks: A Vanguard player from a working Tier 2 family learns their childhood idol secretly negotiated the Axiom sale and has been corporate-aligned for years.
Someone is systematically sabotaging the Vanguard's augmentation maintenance rigs before crucial matches — the evidence points inside the club.
A journalist uncovers that the Vanguard's pre-Axiom championship in 2199 may have been fixed by the very investors who then sold to Axiom.
